market_question: Will the UK designate the IRGC a terrorist organization by June 30?
reasoning: The UK government has been ‘actively considering’ proscription since 2023, backed by a parliamentary committee recommendation. The US designation and recent Iran–Israel hostilities increase pressure. However, diplomatic ties and hostage situations create delay risk. Estimated true probability of designation by mid‑2026 is ~20%, much higher than the 6% market price.
evidence_points: UK Foreign Affairs Committee recommended proscription in July 2023.
Home Office stated ‘actively considering’ designation in 2023.
Precedent: UK proscribed Wagner as terrorist group rapidly after political pressure.
US already designated IRGC as FTO in 2019, isolating UK stance.
sources_consulted: UK Parliament Foreign Affairs Committee reports
BBC News coverage of IRGC proscription debate
UK Home Office and Prime Minister statements 2023–2024
Reuters/Iran International reporting on UK probe into IRGC
